issue.title: Accept progressive JPEG AI results in the native app
issue.body:
**What:** the React Native app's AI result decoder (`experiments/native-architecture/src/ai/jpegResult.ts`) accepts baseline JPEGs only. A progressive JPEG from the generation API is treated as a failed result and shows the "Oh no" print. The committed `web/tests/artifacts` AI outputs are progressive and reproduce it. Found while porting the AI flow (PR 2869); the decoder behaviour predates that PR.

**Where:** `experiments/native-architecture/src/ai/jpegResult.ts`, compared with how shipping accepts the same responses.

**Done when:**
- Every JPEG variant the generation API can return renders as a result, at least baseline and progressive.
- A test decodes a committed progressive fixture.

Part of #2690.
issue.display_title: Accept progressive JPEG AI results in the native app

comments.body: Fixed by #2881, merged into `codex/native-migration`. The RN JPEG check now walks every block's entropy for sequential and progressive files, with SOF0/1/2 accepted. Kotlin and Swift accept SOF1/2 and walk multiple scans. Both committed progressive AI outputs render as results, and a progressive file truncated inside any scan, with EOI appended, is rejected.
